	/* Workaround for http_parser sometimes including the trailing CRLF of a chunk
	 * in the body fragment. This happens when Transfer-Encoding: chunked is used.
	 * The http_parser library's on_body callback should ideally strip this,
	 * but in some versions or specific scenarios, it might not.
	 * We check for F_CHUNKED flag and manually strip the CRLF if present.
	 */
	if ((parser->flags & F_CHUNKED) && rsp.body_frag_len >= 2 &&
	    at[rsp.body_frag_len - 2] == '\r' && at[rsp.body_frag_len - 1] == '\n') {
		rsp.body_frag_len -= 2;
	}

	if (ctx->req->response) {
		return ctx->req->response(&rsp, HTTP_DATA_MORE, ctx->req->user_data);
	}
